notes: «ح» splits the chain; «قالوا، كلهم حدثنا شعبة» joins both branches, so the names after it are the shared tail (rule 3)
«زاد ابن معاذ وصلاة المغرب» is a wording addition by one transmitter of the same saying: a pure wording variant, left out (rule 4)
«أبي» is a bare relation: the father of ابن معاذ is not named
